About

Creative, organized, and focused on growth

I'm a Social Media Manager and Video Editor with over five years of hands-on experience turning brand pages into places people actually want to follow — and buy from.

At Pink Palace Beauty, I took the TikTok page from a near-empty account to thousands of followers and tens of thousands of likes, through consistent video editing, content strategy and ads management. Along the way I've worked across seven-plus brands, always with the same focus: content that gets seen, and campaigns that bring in real leads.
